title: ToxSyn: Reducing Bias in Hate Speech Detection via Synthetic Minority Data in Brazilian Portuguese

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating fine-tuned BERTimbau language models on a group-specific multi-label classification task, using Macro-Recall to measure the model's ability to distinguish genuine hate speech targeted at Black people from non-toxic counterexamples.

Assessing cross-domain generalization by comparing model performance (Macro F1-score and Toxic-Class Recall) when trained on general, informal social media corpora versus formal, minority-focused synthetic datasets to expose severe domain dependency.
